cohort: 205 live births with antenatally detected congenital heart disease
finding: Babies with hypoplastic left heart syndrome, transposition of the great arteries, and arrhythmia had a significantly earlier time to first intervention compared with those with other conditions.
mod_finding: The vaginal delivery rate was 56% (115/205), and there was a non-significant trend towards a higher rate of vaginal delivery after spontaneous labor than after induction.
